\[
\varphi_R(f) = R^{\varepsilon}_f(f \oplus B)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(B\): The structuring element
- \(R^{\varepsilon}_f\): Reconstruction by erosion over f

The dilation fills every dark object the element does not fit into. Reconstruction by erosion over the image then brings back every dark object that kept at least one pixel, with its exact shape.
